source_unit: catalogue article/object, not an individual cryptogram

field_bindings.meaning: parent identity used preferentially for article link

limitations: The UI open group merges native open, part and key. Its 266 objects are not 266 independently open messages.
The article/item and parent fields do not certify an exact cross-catalogue message identity.
Language and cipher-family memberships can be multiple per article; no single-message qualification follows.
Title, date, source-URL and freeform field semantics remain unqualified.
Three initial mixed-system/parent proposals were withdrawn; no eligible shortlist remains.
The resource URL is an observed static literal derivation, not proof of runtime immutability.
Earlier source-reading exposure and deadline exceptions are retained locally; no process-wide blindness claim.
